title: cestrum racemosum var. grande
intro: Cestrum racemosum var. grande, commonly known as the Large Cluster Night-Blooming Jasmine, is a flowering plant in the nightshade family, known for its white, fragrant flowers that bloom in the evening and night. The health benefits of Cestrum racemosum var. grande include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce anxiety and stress, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anticonvulsant effects, which can help in treating insomnia, epilepsy, and other related conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cestrum racemosum var. grande include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
